1 #===============================================================================

    3 #===============================================================================
    4 module Settings
    5   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    6   # Turn order and disobedience
    7   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    8 
    9   # Whether turn order is recalculated after a Pokémon Mega Evolves.
   10   RECALCULATE_TURN_ORDER_AFTER_MEGA_EVOLUTION = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 7)
   11   # Whether turn order is recalculated after a Pokémon's Speed stat changes.
   12   RECALCULATE_TURN_ORDER_AFTER_SPEED_CHANGES  = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 8)
   13   # Whether any Pokémon (originally owned by the player or foreign) can disobey
   14   # the player's commands if the Pokémon is too high a level compared to the
   15   # number of Gym Badges the player has.
   16   ANY_HIGH_LEVEL_POKEMON_CAN_DISOBEY          = false
   17   # Whether foreign Pokémon can disobey the player's commands if the Pokémon is
   18   # too high a level compared to the number of Gym Badges the player has.
   19   FOREIGN_HIGH_LEVEL_POKEMON_CAN_DISOBEY      = true
   20 
   21   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   22   # Mega Evolution
   23   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   24 
   25   # The Game Switch which, while ON, prevents all Pokémon in battle from Mega
   26   # Evolving even if they otherwise could.
   27   NO_MEGA_EVOLUTION = 34
   28 
   29   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   30   # Move usage calculations
   31   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   32 
   33   # Whether a move's physical/special category depends on the move itself as in
   34   # newer Gens (true), or on its type as in older Gens (false).
   35   MOVE_CATEGORY_PER_MOVE          = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 4)
   36   # Whether critical hits do 1.5x damage and have 4 stages (true), or they do 2x
   37   # damage and have 5 stages as in Gen 5 (false). Also determines whether
   38   # critical hit rate can be copied by Transform/Psych Up.
   39   NEW_CRITICAL_HIT_RATE_MECHANICS = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6)
   40   # Whether several effects apply relating to a Pokémon's type:
   41   #   * Electric-type immunity to paralysis
   42   #   * Ghost-type immunity to being trapped
   43   #   * Grass-type immunity to powder moves and Effect Spore
   44   #   * Poison-type Pokémon can't miss when using Toxic
   45   MORE_TYPE_EFFECTS               = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6)
   46   # The minimum number of Gym Badges required to boost each stat of a player's
   47   # Pokémon by 1.1x, in battle only.
   48   NUM_BADGES_BOOST_ATTACK  = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 4) ? 999 : 1
   49   NUM_BADGES_BOOST_DEFENSE = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 4) ? 999 : 5
   50   NUM_BADGES_BOOST_SPATK   = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 4) ? 999 : 7
   51   NUM_BADGES_BOOST_SPDEF   = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 4) ? 999 : 7
   52   NUM_BADGES_BOOST_SPEED   = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 4) ? 999 : 3
   53 
   54   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   55   # Ability and item effects
   56   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   57 
   58   # Whether weather caused by an ability lasts 5 rounds (true) or forever (false).
   59   FIXED_DURATION_WEATHER_FROM_ABILITY = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6)
   60   # Whether X items (X Attack, etc.) raise their stat by 2 stages (true) or 1
   61   # (false).
   62   X_STAT_ITEMS_RAISE_BY_TWO_STAGES    = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 7)
   63   # Whether some Poké Balls have catch rate multipliers from Gen 7 (true) or
   64   # from earlier generations (false).
   65   NEW_POKE_BALL_CATCH_RATES           = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 7)
   66   # Whether Soul Dew powers up Psychic and Dragon-type moves by 20% (true) or
   67   # raises the holder's Special Attack and Special Defense by 50% (false).
   68   SOUL_DEW_POWERS_UP_TYPES            = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 7)
   69 
   70   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   71   # Affection
   72   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   73 
   74   # Whether Pokémon with high happiness will gain more Exp from battles, have a
   75   # chance of avoiding/curing negative effects by themselves, resisting
   76   # fainting, etc.
   77   AFFECTION_EFFECTS        = false
   78   # Whether a Pokémon's happiness is limited to 179, and can only be increased
   79   # further with friendship-raising berries. Related to AFFECTION_EFFECTS by
   80   # default because affection effects only start applying above a happiness of
   81   # 179. Also lowers the happiness evolution threshold to 160.
   82   APPLY_HAPPINESS_SOFT_CAP = AFFECTION_EFFECTS
   83 
   84   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   85   # Capturing Pokémon
   86   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   87 
   88   # Whether the critical capture mechanic applies. Note that its calculation is
   89   # based on a total of 600+ species (i.e. that many species need to be caught
   90   # to provide the greatest critical capture chance of 2.5x), and there may be
   91   # fewer species in your game.
   92   ENABLE_CRITICAL_CAPTURES             = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 5)
   93   # Whether the player is asked what to do with a newly caught Pokémon if their
   94   # party is full. If true, the player can toggle whether they are asked this in
   95   # the Options screen.
   96   NEW_CAPTURE_CAN_REPLACE_PARTY_MEMBER = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 7)
   97 
   98   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   99   # Exp and EV gain
  100   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  101 
  102   # Whether the Exp gained from beating a Pokémon should be scaled depending on
  103   # the gainer's level.
  104   SCALED_EXP_FORMULA            = (MECHANICS_GENERATION == 5 || MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 7)
  105   # Whether the Exp gained from beating a Pokémon should be divided equally
  106   # between each participant (true), or whether each participant should gain
  107   # that much Exp (false). This also applies to Exp gained via the Exp Share
  108   # (held item version) being distributed to all Exp Share holders.
  109   SPLIT_EXP_BETWEEN_GAINERS     = (MECHANICS_GENERATION <= 5)
  110   # Whether the Exp gained from beating a Pokémon is multiplied by 1.5 if that
  111   # Pokémon is owned by another trainer.
  112   MORE_EXP_FROM_TRAINER_POKEMON = (MECHANICS_GENERATION <= 6)
  113   # Whether a Pokémon holding a Power item gains 8 (true) or 4 (false) EVs in
  114   # the relevant stat.
  115   MORE_EVS_FROM_POWER_ITEMS     = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 7)
  116   # Whether Pokémon gain Exp for capturing a Pokémon.
  117   GAIN_EXP_FOR_CAPTURE          = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6)
  118 
  119   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  120   # End of battle
  121   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  122 
  123   # The Game Switch which, while ON, prevents the player from losing money if
  124   # they lose a battle (they can still gain money from trainers for winning).
  125   NO_MONEY_LOSS                       = 33
  126   # Whether party Pokémon check whether they can evolve after all battles
  127   # regardless of the outcome (true), or only after battles the player won (false).
  128   CHECK_EVOLUTION_AFTER_ALL_BATTLES   = (MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6)
  129   # Whether fainted Pokémon can try to evolve after a battle.
  130   CHECK_EVOLUTION_FOR_FAINTED_POKEMON = true
  131 
  132   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  133   # AI
  134   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  135 
  136   # Whether wild Pokémon with the "Legendary", "Mythical" or "UltraBeast" flag
  137   # (as defined in pokemon.txt) have a smarter AI. Their skill level is set to
  138   # 32, which is a medium skill level.
  139   SMARTER_WILD_LEGENDARY_POKEMON = true
  140 end
